abstract: A cell line designated HUOT was established from a recurrent tumor of human ovarian malignant teratoma. The cell line grew slowly and stably and serial passages were performed 50 times within 35 months. The cells, polygonal or spindle, with neoplastic and pleomorphic features grew in multiple layers and without contact inhibition. Population doubling time was 98 hours and the plating efficiency was less than 6%. The chromosome number varied from 43 to over 256, and the modal number was stable at the hyperdiploid range (52-56). The cultured cells produced anaplastic carcinomas by heterotransplantation into the subcutis of nude mice and were characterized as producing large amounts of alpha-fetoprotein, in vitro, at the stationary growth phase and as forming cystlike structures. Dibutyl cAMP suppressed the cellular proliferation and increased the production of alpha-fetoprotein. Therefore, this HUOT line is expected to have a wide application for various laboratory studies.
abstract_ja: 卵巣悪性奇形腫の再発腫瘍から細胞株HUOTを樹立した。この細胞株は緩徐かつ安定に増殖し、35か月間に50回の継代を行った。細胞は多角形または紡錘形で、腫瘍性・多形性の特徴を示し、接触阻害を伴わず多層に増殖した。倍加時間は98時間、プレーティング効率は6%未満であった。染色体数は43から256以上まで変動し、最頻値は52〜56の高二倍体域で安定していた。培養細胞をヌードマウスの皮下に異種移植すると未分化癌を生じた。また、定常増殖期のin vitroにおいて多量のαフェトプロテイン(AFP)を産生することが特徴で、嚢胞様構造を形成した。ジブチルcAMPは細胞増殖を抑制し、AFP産生を増加させた。したがって、このHUOT株は各種の基礎研究への広い応用が期待される。
